title: Configuration positions
statement: For a natural number $k$, configuration positions are of three kinds: a work-cell position, specified by a time $t$, a track $	au 	ext{ with } 0 \leq \tau < k$, and a cell coordinate $r$; an input position, specified by a time $t$ and an input coordinate $p$; or a snapshot position, specified by a time $t$.
